items.title: Lemon Nash Interview, 1961-06-20
items.q: I have his number at home.

ctx.x: I heard he's in California playing.

Johnnie Simmons is in California too. I have his number at home. He lived on Wall Street in California. I can't think of that number. Yeah. But he do live on Wall Street, huh? That's right. That's right. I just, at home.
How about the Hustlers Saloon on either Rampart or Dryads and Perdido?
